description: Source code for a WolfSSL-based cryptographic utility that generates RSA/ECC keys and self-signed certificates, including functions for key generation, certificate creation, and file writing.

methods.name: write_file
methods.description: Writes a buffer to a specified file or standard error, handling file opening, writing, syncing, and closing.

methods.name: write_key
methods.description: Converts cryptographic keys to DER or PEM format and writes them to a file.

methods.name: gen_key
methods.description: Generates an ECC or RSA key pair based on specified parameters.

methods.name: selfsigned
methods.description: Creates a self-signed certificate with specified parameters, including key generation and certificate signing.

methods.name: dokey
methods.description: Generates a cryptographic key (ECC or RSA) with optional parameters and writes it to a file.
